answer: 849 sites are removed when filtering sites that do not show >90% or <10% methylation in Zebra Finch (leaving 291 sites that show methylation >90% or <10% in at least one sample, out of 1,140 total CpG sites). If non-strict thresholds are applied (>=90% or <=10%), 837 sites are removed. Alternatively, if the filtering operation refers to removing sites that show >90% or <10% methylation, 291 sites are removed (303 for non-strict).
